business: peak eligible transactions per second by operation class
data growth per day and retention
failure scenario that must still meet the objective
measured: read and hit blocks per transaction

equations.primary_space_floor: live_bytes + index_bytes + bloat_allowance + maintenance_workspace + retained_wal + emergency_margin

decision_rules: Use an operation-weighted demand model; do not multiply one average TPS by one universal cost.
Keep a separate normal-state and declared-failure-state model.
A closed-loop maximum-throughput result is an upper-bound probe, not an admitted-load SLO.
If the client is saturated, repeat from a stronger or distributed load generator.
If a factor is unmeasured, retain it as an unknown rather than assigning a convenient zero.
Trigger provisioning early enough to acquire, configure, load, validate, and roll back capacity.

publication_contract.public_values: allowlisted aggregate results and declared limitations only
publication_contract.private_values: raw transaction logs, raw system samples, raw SQL snapshots, and raw VictoriaMetrics responses
